responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s symbolic value hierarchy. This file provides common svalue services such as printing, JSON conversion, constant/region/cast unwrapping, liveness and merge decisions, and bit-range extraction/folding, along with concrete behavior for symbolic-value subclasses including compound, conjured, asm-output, and const-function-result values so region_model and constraint/store logic can reason about abstract program values consistently.
same_name_distinction: Implements the behavior of the symbolic-value hierarchy from svalue.h, including printing/JSON conversion, constant and region unwrapping, merge decisions, bit-range extraction and folding, and subclass-specific visitors and dumps, rather than declaring the svalue taxonomy and class structure.
